title: Home guide: changing shape
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Everyday materials and how they change (Muck, Mess & Mixtures and Will It Degrade?)
source: Written for science/y2 lesson 7 (Home practical guide: changing shape (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how materials change shape when we squash, bend, stretch and twist them.
equipment: Play dough or salt dough (flour, salt, water)
safety: Rubber bands can snap: stretch them gently, away from your face
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Squash each material with your hand.
Watch each time: does it go back to its shape?
